response_texts: Old orcish soldiers... they must be here seeking a good death, I guess. Which clan are they from?
Ruskhar, a clan of master archers worshipping the White Owl. This one heard they are also excellent swordsmen.
They are as fearless of death as the Nords, yes? So do not bother fighting them fairly.
I'm aware. I have no intention of playing to their strengths. Keep our distance and just keep hitting them, right?
Correct. For there is no honor in this fight, no?
Don't even say it. We're just here for loot to ensure our own survival.
Do not be so hard on yourself. As a caring parental figure, it makes Ja'zel sad to hear you like this.
...I never thought of you as a parent. And I never will.
Ozwald has not changed from the little boy he was. But Ja'zel has learned to love even his little rebellions.
Anyway, what's the nature of the curse that was placed on us?
Laza. The shepherd trapped in the past. The essence of his curse is to long for something that cannot truly be there anymore.
Laza... But that was a long time ago, wasn't it? Did he even live?
You are right, he was not supposed to live. For all the nomads who were attacked by Lamae died, no?
So, all you're saying is that all this with Laza is just a way for you to escape death?
They mimic an owl. It is as easy as imitating a voice...
Why bother imitating an owl at all? Why not a hare or something?
They already failed with a hare, yes? They learn from mistakes far better than mortals.
O tainted soul. Can you not hear her sobbing? She is also your redemption. Stained by blue and therefore ravaged by vindictive poison.
It is foolish to trust that cat. So turn back. For we are all nothing but lice. Partake in Kyne's Feast of Love!
I... I'm back...
Welcome back. Are you hungry? I warmed up the soup for you.
Thank you, Groll. And... I'm sorry I was acting like a selfish brat...
That's all right. It's nothing compared to what I was like at your age. All is well.
Groll, where is uncle Brandt?
He drank himself to sleep in the kitchen. If you want to talk to him, you'd better do that tomorrow.
All right, I understand. The soup today is delicious as always, Groll.
Thank you, Lalanoah. There's also a sweet roll. Do you think you can manage it?
Yes, I'll have it, I'll have it!
Intruders are passing through the city to the Chamber. Guards, secure the facility!
A special reward will be given to those who deal with the intruders. Kill them all!
It is up to you whether your journey here will be a long or short one.
Start this journey once more. Even if you walk the same path, you will see a different scenery. The outcome up to you.
No matter how many times you repeat it... your journey will continue until you give up on it. It's all up to you.
This is your story from this point on. Even we were not allowed to spin it... So this is a gamble for all of us.
We cannot truly create anything, you know? We can only see the desires of your mortal souls.
I am looking forward to seeing where your wish takes you. And once it comes true, I hope you will remember our kindness.
Well, we are here. I am looking forward to seeing you again.
Well, here we are. I hope this time your wish comes true.
Well, here we are. We will repeat this again and again until your wish comes true.
Is it okay... to flush that baby down the river?
Of course. This river flows through the Cradle Woods in the Reach until it reaches Falkreath... underneath.
Flushing the baby here is our next step. In mid-flow, it will be picked up by the kind-hearted Anem, yes?
How do you know that? Did the Eyes of Hinnom tell you that?
Hmm, that is simply a tool, no? It can only be used for surveillance and assassination, at best. But Ja'zel has a vague idea of how these things work, yes?
Anem... She is kind. She will be compelled to pick up the baby, compelled to save it. Even if it means giving her own life to do so.
Is this flow... an example of the Owl's wisdom as well?
Ja'zel is confident that it is. He has learned so from Yelem's legacy, yes? And he cannot deny that even that is the result of being guided by the Owl.
I dread to even think about this, but... Are they going to contact us directly or...?
All the Owl can do is offer guidance. Excessive interference on his part would change the flow itself, yes? That is how great his power is.
That's tremendous. So what's at the end of this flow?
Khajiit told you, it is Falkreath. Underground there still rests a statue of an old god, worshipped by the Nedes.
Anem will wash the baby... and the river's flow will carry its curse and defile the statue of this god.
That will be a disaster for Falkreath!
...Strange. The time breach has already closed. Was it even here or was it just a temporary phenomenon?
No doubt about it. The consumption of chocolate milk in Falkreath has risen by 50% over the last week.
Besides, the breach here has already been stitched up by someone. Can't you see the wispy threads?
I can't see them at all. That means there must have been interference from a higher plane... Could a Daedric Prince be involved?
Don't forget to account for beavers. They hate this world, after all. The fact that they're always gnawing on something is proof of that.
You're so quick to blame beavers for everything. What happened in the past?
They build dams to block the flow of water and to store it. Horrible stuff!
Ah, so you are still alive? ...Do you want a replacement for that chick, hmm? But it is too late.
Too late now. The Chick Traders are closed. This one does not have a single chick to sell you anymore.
You are free now. Forget everything and walk away, live somewhere far away, yes? It is all over.
But if you insist... By all means, press on. We shall not get along anymore, but Khajiit promises to give you a warm reception.
That baby looks very different from when we found it in the Cradle Woods... What did you do to it?
You were looking at a witch's rotting placenta there, yes? It was very difficult to separate them.
But this child looks alive...
It is not. But it is not dead, either.
What do you mean? You keep talking in circles and I really don't understand you!
It is more like a stone or a wind-chime than a living thing, yes? Or more precisely, it is both a star and its rotation.
But the point is, it is power itself. Pure curse. Perhaps think of it like a curse given flesh, yes?
So it's simply there, a bit like a rock lying at the side of the road?
Correct. If you stumble over it, you will fall, no?
Khajiit was invited here by the smell of flowers... This is interesting.
You are blessed. But you must remain pure.
Unless you remain pure, the blood curse will crawl towards you. Therefore... You must remain pure.
This... this can't happen... not like this... Does that mean we have no choice but to keep killing each other...? We're no better than wild beasts then... No, even worse.
...How terrifying... I should have never seen such a future. But there must be more hope ahead... there must be!
Oh, ha ha... So I'm just an echo... What a wonderful future... and in it, Vivec is going to give birth to that child...
The sewer cleaning operation caused more damage than expected. Several heavily armored automatons were destroyed.
Send more reinforcements immediately. Eradicate the damn rats!
O little louse. Why are you heading towards the blood curse? Chicks should remain pure.
It is foolish to smear yourself with mud. So turn back. It is only a single chick's sorrow.
Come with me... Ozwald... Together...
Alma! Alma! Isk edur lo, Cruviah! Os e iru!
Alma! Alma! Cruviah edur iru!
